The race will take place on April 15th, 2026, as part of the Chlapácký běh series, with results available on the organizer's website.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The Zbraslavská VAŠE LIGA 2026 is a mountain cross race in Prague-Zbraslav, presenting a challenging challenge with a elevation gain of 500 meters over a 7 km course. During the race, participants will face three demanding ascents and descents that test their strength and endurance. The race starts at 6:00 PM at the Prague-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners seeking an intense trail experience in an urban environment with natural elements. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA under the leadership of Petr Lundák.
course_highlights: 7 km mountain cross/trail race
Elevation gain of 500 meters
Three demanding ascents and descents
additional: The race is a mountain cross/trail with significant elevation gain and challenging sections. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA, contact person Petr Lundák. The start is at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of the VAŠE LIGA series. The course is designed for trail runners, registration is possible online, and the start and finish are at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of a series of mountain runs and offers both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
description: Spring Olymp Run is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7, at the OLYMP CSMV complex. It offers three courses of different lengths (5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km), which run through nature and are suitable for runners of various levels. The race is organized by PSK Olymp Prague and is part of the running community of the Czech Athletic Federation. The main category starts at 18:55, allowing runners to enjoy the evening atmosphere of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the courses in Stromovka Park
Three course lengths: 5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km
Start and finish at the OLYMP CSMV complex in Prague 7
additional: Registrations are only possible online until October 8, 2026, at midnight; registrations on the race day are not accepted by the organizers. The first category starts at 16:00, the main category starts at 18:55. The organizer is PSK Olymp Prague, z.s., contact person Jindřich Linhart. The race takes place in the Olymp complex area, with various age categories, online registration until October 8, 2026, course lengths of 3.3 km, 4.4 km, and 5.5 km, and is open to the general public.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc. The course runs on asphalt paths and participants complete three laps of 3.343 km each, with the first lap being slightly shorter. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026 and offers categories based on age as well as an open run regardless of age. The award ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion, and runners receive small sweet gifts for placing on the podium.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km lap on asphalt paths in Smetanovy Sady
The race is run 3 times, with the first lap being 28 meters shorter
Start and finish at the Music Pavilion in Smetanovy Sady
additional: Pre-registration of participants takes place on-site. Runners must have a chip card with a credit of at least 70 CZK, which will be deducted during registration. Items can be stored in the start/finish area. The race is run according to road running rules, each participant at their own risk. The event takes place in April 2026, with information available about registration, prices, and rules, and is part of the local running series organized by TJ Liga stovkařů.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity run held on April 16, 2026, in Flora Park. The race starts at 9:00 PM, and participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which covers the event costs and the other half goes to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program including a concert and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband. Capacity is limited for safety and participant comfort.
course_highlights: Course in Flora Park in Olomouc
Option to choose between 2.5 km and 5 km routes
Night run with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration counters are open from 7:00 PM. Starter packs are available with options including a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort can enter for free and can purchase a starter pack on-site for 250 CZK. The event capacity is limited for safety and comfort. The accompanying program includes a concert by Rodan from 8:00 PM. The route is also suitable for walking. The registration fee supports the visually impaired. The start is from 7:00 PM to 8:45 PM, the accompanying program runs from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and the starter pack includes a headlamp or sports headband.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Kostel svaté Kateřiny, Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena je při registraci a zaplacení do 15.4.2025
description: We invite all runners to the traditional 18th edition of the Kateřinský Run in Hrabová, which will take place on April 16, 2026, in Ostrava-Hrabová. The main route runs around the historic St. Catherine's Church, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, children's races, and Nordic Walking on 5 km. Participants will enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: The route runs around St. Catherine's Church in Ostrava-Hrabová
Available courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, including children's races and 5 km Nordic Walking
Start and registration at the Cultural House Ostrava - Hrabová, Bažanova Street
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The start number is with a chip and is refundable. The registration fee includes a medal for those registered by April 13, 2026, post-race refreshments, changing rooms and toilets, SMS result service, and participation in the Hrabovský and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for 5 km). Recommended transportation is buses DPO lines 27, 41, 39, 77 with a stop at Hrabová, kostelík. Results are announced within 20 minutes at the registration site after the race. For safety reasons, the use of headphones during the race is not allowed. The 5 km and 2.5 km courses include running, Nordic Walking, and children's races (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1000 m). The surface is asphalt, suitable for all age groups, promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
location: TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championship along with the 24th Hanácký Half Marathon is a traditional running event organized by the Olomouc Athletic Club. The race takes place in the heart of Olomouc and offers quality organization at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The club boasts a rich history and participation of its athletes in major European and world competitions. The race is suitable for a wide running public, who can enjoy the atmosphere of a championship half marathon in the beautiful environment of Moravia.
course_highlights: Regional Championship of Moravia and Silesia in Half Marathon
24th Hanácký Half Marathon with a traditional venue in Olomouc
Opportunity for runners of all levels to participate in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The races include various runs and events, detailed course information and registration have not yet been published

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč (předem), 200 Kč (na místě) pro dospělé; 30 Kč (předem), 50 Kč (na místě) pro děti; 50 Kč za štafetu
description: The Javorka Run is a traditional spring running race with many years of history, held regularly in April in the beautiful environment of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The main race over 6 km is among the fast races because the course runs on hard park paths and is only slightly hilly. The race is part of the regional running series ISCAREX Cup and offers quality performance experiences for runners of all categories. In addition to the main race, there are also children's categories and team relays.
course_highlights: The 6 km course runs on hard park paths (gravel, paving)
Loop courses from 200 m to 1200 m, marked with flags according to categories
Slightly hilly profile of the track in a beautiful park environment
additional: Registration is possible in advance online or on the day of the race no later than 20 minutes before the start of the respective category. The race facilities are at the outdoor stage (Music Pavilion) next to Javorka Restaurant. Starts: children's categories at 9:30, main race at 11:30, team relays at 12:10. The race takes place in Javorka Park, registration is possible online or on-site, the track is surface-paved with gentle inclines and turns. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers various categories including athletes with disabilities.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovic, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zehrovický Kalspotkros is a cross-country running race covering a distance of 6.2 km with a hilly profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup and offers runners an interesting and challenging course in a natural environment. This race is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in the form of hilly terrain. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a quality race atmosphere and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of 6.2 km
Hilly profile with undulating terrain
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026, with the start scheduled for 10:30 AM and registration from 9:00 to 10:00 AM. More information is available in the regulations on the official website.

name: Listonošův krpál
location: Praha - Jarov (u Zbraslavi), Praha, Czech Republic
description: Listonošův krpál is a hill race in Prague - Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with an elevation gain of 150 meters. This race is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts and uphill runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, providing a dynamic and attractive racing experience.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.88 km
Elevation gain 150 m
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026. Registration details are not specified. It is part of the mountain running series in Prague.

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Tolštejn Estate Race Jiřetín pod Jedlovou - Jedlová is a mountain uphill run 6 km long with an elevation gain of 340 meters, aiming to reach the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course with beautiful views. This race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the Lusatian Mountains.
course_highlights: Length of the course 6 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Finish at the summit of Jedlová
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: The race is open to the general public, registration is possible online, and children can participate for free. The event is combined with opportunities for trips around the area, including visits to the Jedlová lookout tower and the Tolštejn ruins.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB: I Don't Want to Be Last is a running race held in Dvůr Králové Safari Park, offering a unique experience of running in an African and walking safari environment. The race is open to the general public and offers three routes: 2 km family run, 5 km, and 10 km race, with the 10 km route being two laps of the 5 km course. The surface of the routes is mainly paved asphalt, with start and finish at the main entrance to the safari park. Included in the registration fee is free entry to the safari park on race day and support for the rescue of bald zebras.
course_highlights: The route passes through African and walking safaris
Mainly paved asphalt surface
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park
additional: Race bibs are equipped with a chip that remains with the runner. The registration fee includes free entry to the safari park on race day, a registration bag with gifts from partners, a meal voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, light refreshments at the finish line (water, fruit), and accompanying activities for children at the main partner ČSOB's stand. The race is suitable for families and more experienced runners, with online registration available for various dates. The event is combined with activities in the safari park and supports nature conservation.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
description: Spring Run in Dražovka in Hořovice is a traditional trophy race that invites competitors of all ages to an active sporting experience. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Dražovka and offers an opportunity for sports enjoyment and meeting other runners. Registration is possible online at brdskypohar.cz or directly on-site on the day of the race. We look forward to your participation and wish everyone much success and joy in running.
course_highlights: Trophy race in the picturesque environment of Dražovka
Suitable for both large and small competitors
Online registration available as well as on-site
additional: Registration is preferred online at www.brdskypohar.cz, but on-site registration on the race day is also possible. Trail run suitable for all age groups, registration via the website, same-day registration on-site is available.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Husínský cross-country is a traditional spring running race in Tajanov near Klatovy, which was created as a replacement for the canceled Klatovská patnáctka. The race has been held since 2012 and is part of the prestigious Ešus league series. Men run three laps, women and girls two laps, with each lap approximately 3.6 km long and mostly on forest paths with a section on smooth asphalt. In recent years, the course has returned to the original longer variant around the Husín forest. The main referee is running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer.
course_highlights: Circuit approximately 3.6 km with two-thirds on forest paths
One-third of the course runs on smooth asphalt
Course runs around the Husín forest
additional: The race is part of the Ešus league series, which will have its 42nd edition in 2026 and includes 22 races. Men run 10.5 km (3 laps), women and men over 70 run 7 km (2 laps). The start is at the volleyball courts in Tajanov. The organizer is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the prestigious Ešus league series, which has previously been held virtually due to the pandemic. The event attracts a wide participation and has a long tradition in the region.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Bakov nad Jizerou, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou, now in its 43rd year. The race takes place on a certified course of 21.097 km, which runs along a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality and includes ascents and descents. The start is at 10:00 AM at the square in Bakov nad Jizerou, and the race offers monetary and material prizes for the best men and women. Registrations are possible in advance with a lower starting fee or on the race day for a higher fee.
course_highlights: Certified course of 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with variable surface quality
Refreshment stations at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:45 AM in a building approximately 150 meters from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. A prize of 2000 CZK is awarded for breaking course records in the absolute categories of men and women. The entry fee can be paid by bank transfer or on the race day at the venue. The route runs along a hilly asphalt road with alternating surface quality, there are refreshment stations on the course, and categories are announced by age, with the possibility of winning prizes for records.

name: Ještěd SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd SkyRace® is a traditional trail running race held in the beautiful environment of the Ještěd ridge near Liberec. The race offers several route options, including the premier SkyRace route with a length of 22 km and an elevation gain of 1390 m, as well as shorter trails Trail (13 km) and Easy (6 km). The event is suitable for runners of all levels, including races for children and canicross. The start and finish are located in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd, providing stunning views and challenging terrain. The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: Premier SkyRace route: 22 km with 1390 m elevation gain
Other routes: Trail 13 km / 945 m+, Easy 6 km / 300 m+
Start and finish in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd
additional: The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM. The races include children's categories and canicross. Start and finish are in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd. The routes are challenging with significant elevation gain, suitable for mountain running enthusiasts. Distances are 6 km, 13 km, and 22 km; accompanying events, trail camps, merchandising, registration, entertainment, and nutrition are available during the race weekend.

name: Pyšelský kopeček
organizer: parta běžců z Pyšel a Kopeček 2016, z.s.
description: Pyšelský Kopeček is a traditional trail run in the picturesque environment of Pyšel, offering routes for all levels of runners from recreational to ultramarathoners. The course is 90% forest trails and includes loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km. Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are designated as UTMB index races, attracting experienced runners. The start and finish are at the football field in Pyšel, which provides facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The event is suitable for the general public and is accompanied by children's races and canicross.
course_highlights: Course is 90% forest trails
Loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km
Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are UTMB index races
additional: The race has a limit of 250 participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and showers are available at the start and finish area. Parking is available at designated spots outside the start area, respecting residents. For canicross, there are refreshment stations for dogs along the course. Children's races have manual timing, adult categories use electronic timing. Starts are divided into waves from 10:00 to 14:15 with winners announced at 17:00. The ultraPUNKtrail courses of 52 km and 105 km branch off and reconnect with the classic 21 km route. The race includes registration, timing, and facilities at the start and finish; it is also suitable for children and beginners.

name: Run for ProCit
price_range: 550 Kč online, 600 Kč na místě, děti do 10 let zdarma
description: RUN for ProCit is a charitable family run organized by the civic association ProCit in Pilsen, supporting families with children with autism spectrum disorder. The event takes place annually in April on the occasion of World Autism Awareness Day and offers routes for children and adults, including the possibility of Nordic walking. The run is complemented by a rich accompanying program for children and parents and is dog-friendly, so runners with dogs can also participate. The proceeds from registration fees and accompanying activities are donated to support families with children with autism.
course_highlights: 2 children's routes without registration and time measurement
2 km and 5 km routes with time measurement and winners announced
Color zone on the track, which can be run around
additional: On-site registration from 8:30 AM. Children's runs start at 10:00 and 10:10, 2 km run at 10:15, 5 km run at 10:45. Possibility to complete the 2 km route as Nordic walking with an instructor. Every participant who crosses the finish line receives a commemorative medal. The run is dog-friendly. On-site charity raffle and refreshments. Registration from 8:30, starts from 10:00, charity event, opportunity to purchase small gifts and raffle tickets.

name: Dačická 14
location: Dačice, Rybník Peráček, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Sdružení běžců Dačic, Běh Vysočiny z. s.
price_range: 100 Kč - 150 Kč, mládež do 17 let zdarma
description: Dačická 14 is a traditional running race held in Dačice, South Bohemia, on April 18, 2026. It offers various courses and categories, including for adults, youth, and children, with predominantly mixed terrain consisting of fields, forest paths, and asphalt sections. The event is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive enthusiasts, with the opportunity to win valuable prizes and set record times.
course_highlights: Various course lengths including 13.5 km, 9.7 km, 4.3 km, and 1.475 km
Mixed terrain including fields, forest paths, and asphalt sections
Categories for different age groups including youth and children
additional: The race offers multiple distances and categories, registration is possible online and on-site, including for children and youth categories. The course runs through fields, forest paths, and park trails, with opportunities to win prizes for record times and is complemented by refreshments and water during the race.

name: ŘepoRun
description: ŘepoRun is a running race held in Řeporyje, Prague, offering courses for children and adults. The race is organized by the enthusiastic group Run Labe Run and is intended for all running enthusiasts. The route runs around Řeporyje, and participants receive a start package and a medal after finishing. Registration is available online with a lower entry fee until April 10, 2026; later, on-site registration is possible until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: The route runs around Řeporyje
Children's courses 200 m, 600 m, and 1300 m
Time measured with a chip on the start number
additional: Start packages can be picked up from 9:00 to 11:30 for children and from 10:00 to 11:45 for adults. The time is measured using a chip on the start number, which is not returned. After the race, a baggage storage service is available. Parking is limited; public transport is recommended. On-site registration is possible until capacity is reached. Registration is open until April 10, 2026. Race categories include various distances, with starts divided by age groups. The race features chip timing.

name: Děčín RunFest
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a friendly sporting event in Děčín that offers various running disciplines including a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run, and children's races. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of the Elbe Valley at Mariánská Louka and is suitable for all age groups and fitness levels. The program also includes Nordic Walking and accompanying activities that ensure fun and sporting experiences for the whole family.
course_highlights: various distances including half marathon and 5 km
friendly environment in nature in the Elbe Valley
accompanying activities for children and adults
additional: The event is family-friendly and offers various sports activities. Registration is possible online. The races are suitable for all age groups and will be held in April 2026.

name: Kotva race
location: T.J. Sokol Maxičky, Děčín, Czech Republic
price_range: 250,- to 800,- CZK podle kategorie a data registrace
description: The Kotva race is an obstacle course race held in Děčín that combines a sporting challenge with the values of the Sokol movement. The race takes place on April 18, 2026, and offers a main race for participants born in 2011 and earlier, as well as children's and canicross categories. Participants can look forward to a demanding terrain with obstacles that will test their strength, endurance, and determination. Registration is possible online and on-site with an increased starting fee, and parental consent is required for competitors under 18.
course_highlights: Obstacle course race in terrain with various challenging obstacles
Course suitable for competitors born in 2011 and earlier
Categories for children and canicross
additional: On-site registration is possible on the day of the race from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race and from 11:30 to 12:15 for the children's race with an increased entry fee. For competitors under 18, written parental consent and submission of a signed legal responsibility statement (REVERZ) are required. It is recommended to arrive early to avoid waiting in line. The race includes the main run, canicross, and children's races. Registration must be completed in advance. The race is open to the general public, including people with disabilities and children from 2 years old.

name: Žákovský běh Bakovem
location: Atletická dráha u základní školy, Bakov nad Jizerou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.6 km, 0.4 km, 0.2 km
organizer: Školní sportovní klub při ZŠ Bakov nad Jizerou
description: The Student Run Bakov is a traditional children's running race held since 2002 in Bakov nad Jizerou. The races take place on the athletic track at the elementary school, where children can run in trainers. Competitions are held in twelve categories from preschoolers to juniors, including relay races. The event is part of the accompanying program of the Bakov Half Marathon and is known for its friendly atmosphere and recognition of the best competitors with diplomas, medals, and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: Circuits around the athletic track at the elementary school
Circuit length of 313 meters
Running on the sidewalk, possibility to use trainers
additional: Participant registration takes place on the day of the race in the theater hall of the elementary school and ends 30 minutes before the start of the respective category. The race is free of charge. Awards include diplomas, medals, and small sports supplies; relays include sweets and gifts from sponsors. The race has been moved from the square to the athletic track due to reconstruction of the square. The race will be held in April 2026, featuring various distances from 200 m to 1500 m, and is open to the general public. Applications can be submitted via the race's website or Facebook page.

name: VALAŠSKÝ TRHÁK
location: Městský park Rožnov, Rožnov pod Radhoštěm, Czech Republic
description: Valasský Trak 2026 is a half marathon held on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in the City Park in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm. This race offers a sporting atmosphere in the heart of the city and is ideal for runners who want to experience running in a beautiful environment with a friendly community. The start and finish are located in the park, ensuring convenient access and a pleasant environment for participants. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Half marathon in City Park Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Start and finish in the park with a pleasant sporting atmosphere
Run in the heart of the city with a friendly community
additional: The event also includes cultural activities such as an Easter creative workshop, concerts, and workshops in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm.

name: TIŠNOVSKÉ KOZY 2026
location: Tišnov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 200 Kč for main race, free for children

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dětské běhy zdarma, nutná online registrace

description: Tišnovské Kozy 2026 is a charity trail run taking place on April 18 in Tišnov. The race offers two options - a relay for pairs over 2x5 km and an individual race over 10 km, guided through the scenic Tišnov nature with gentle ascents and flat sections. The event celebrates movement, fun, and community, with accompanying activities for children and adults. All proceeds from registration fees and jersey sales are donated to support the Lokomoce association and the Člověče, hýbej se! initiative.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Tišnov nature with gentle ascents and flat sections
A time limit of 3 hours allows completing the course even on foot
Start and finish at the Tišnov elementary school athletic oval, with a climb to Květnice and Klucanina
additional: Children's races are free but require online registration due to timing chips. The start and finish are at the Tišnov elementary school athletic oval. The main race has a time limit of 3 hours. An original running jersey with your name is available for order until March 8, 2026. After the race, a raffle with valuable prizes takes place. The accompanying program includes archery, airsoft shooting range, face painting, music and drum shows, and other activities for children and adults. The trail race can be registered online, with proceeds supporting children's initiatives. The event also includes walking, refreshments, and activities for all age groups.

name: Děčín Run Fest 2026
price_range: 399,- Kč to 850,- Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: Děčín RunFest 2026 is a traditional running event held on April 18th in Děčín at Mariánská louka along the Labská cycle path. It offers a half marathon, a 5 km run, a family run, children's races, and a relay for pairs, including a Nordic Walking half marathon. The event is complemented by presentations of sports activities and an accompanying program that invites all age groups to active sports and family entertainment. Starts are divided from morning to afternoon with results announced and a charitable focus for the family and children's runs.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 5 km run along the Labská cycle path
Family run and children's races of various lengths
Nordic Walking half marathon and relay for pairs
additional: Registration from 08:30 to 12:55, with the latest registration 20 minutes before the start. Starts are divided into Nordic Walking half marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, family run, and children's races. The family and children's runs have a charitable focus, with registration fees going to charitable causes. The relay for pairs involves a handover at the turnaround point. Categories are based on age and gender. The event includes an accompanying program and sale of sports equipment. It takes place at Mariánská louka and around the Labská cycle path in Děčín.

name: Běh do vrchu Jiřetín - Jedlová
description: The Jiřetín - Jedlová uphill run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Varnsdorf Running Club, taking place on Saturday, April 18, 2026, in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging route of 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 meters, leading from 434 meters above sea level to the summit of Jedlová Mountain at 774 meters above sea level. The course is a combination of asphalt, gravel, and forest paths. Participants start at 8:00 AM from the sports complex and can look forward to monetary prizes and a running raffle.
course_highlights: Length of the course 5.7 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Surface: 10% asphalt, 60% gravel, 30% forest paths
Start at the sports complex in Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, finish at the top of Jedlová Mountain
additional: Categories by age from juniors to seniors, monetary prizes for category winners and for breaking the course record, running raffle with prize draws, race at own risk, basic medical care provided. Terrain: hilly, trail; registration: online or on-site; Memorial of Milan Krupka.

name: Dehtářská 10°

description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where participants conquer Petřín Hill in three different ways: by interval running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, running uphill with a mass start, and interval running down a slope on an unpaved path and stairs. Traditional endurance run with a friendly atmosphere

The race is complemented by an accompanying program and services for competitors including refreshments, changing rooms, and medical services.

Friendly atmosphere and accompanying program

The race is part of a series of trail events in the Czech Republic, offering various course levels, family categories, and an accompanying program for all age groups.

The race includes various disciplines such as canicross, an ultra 9-hour run, and other activities. For 2026, a program focused on safety and fairness is prepared, with winners announced and participation medals for all. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced ultramarathoners, emphasizing respect for nature and race rules.

The Ultra 9H race lasts continuously for 9 hours on a 5 km loop
Canicross races with categories Racing Dog and Hobby Dog with various distances
additional: Canicross race registration is from 7:00 to 8:00, starting in categories Racing Dog and Hobby Dog with different distances. All participants receive a medal and a voucher. The Ultra 9H race is an extreme endurance run with mandatory headlamps from 16:00 to 18:00. Facilities for competitors are at the start and finish with a party tent and resting area. The race includes various categories, supports the Pokrok Dětem Children's Neurorehabilitation Center, offers online registration, and accompanying activities such as physiotherapy and counseling.

name: Dokola Kletě
location: Třísov u Českého Krumlova, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Around Kleť there is a genuine mountain marathon and half marathon in the Blanský les Protected Landscape Area, offering challenging ascents, technical descents, and beautiful views of the surroundings of Klet. The race is intended for runners seeking a tough spring fitness test in the terrain, suitable for both amateurs and experienced ultramarathoners. The course runs on forest and field paths, trails, and asphalt with clear markings and refreshment stations. The start and finish are in Třísov near Český Krumlov. The race takes place on April 25, 2026.
course_highlights: Two loops around Klet in the Blanský les Protected Landscape Area
Long ascents and technical descents on forest trails
Views from around Klet and four refreshment stations on the course
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 8:00 at the start location. The participant limit is 200 runners. The time limit for the long route is 8 hours with a checkpoint at the halfway point. Mandatory equipment includes a personal cup, mobile phone, rescue foil, and suitable clothing. Parking is available directly at the start in Třísov, with limited capacity; carpooling is recommended. The race includes registration, parking, and safety rules, which are detailed on the website. There are various course lengths available, including 45 km and 44 km, with support and timing services.

name: VOKOLO trail
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo TRAIL is a spring running race held on April 25, 2026, around the Brno Dam. It offers a beautiful, hilly course in natural terrain with stunning views of the water surface and the historic Veveří Castle. The race is designed for runners who want to experience a personal challenge and push their limits on a moderately difficult course. It also features a unique steamer relay, combining running and boat travel on the dam. The organizer is the Brno Club of Running and Sports Activities z.s., which emphasizes quality facilities and participant safety.
course_highlights: 18 km hilly course in natural terrain along both banks of the Brno Dam
Stunning views of the water surface and Veveří Castle
Unique steamer relay 2x 9 km with crossing the dam
additional: The race capacity is limited to 700 runners. The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, a locker tag, partner vouchers, a voucher for hot soup after the race, and a ticket for the tombola. There are separate changing rooms, a guarded baggage storage, and storage for bikes and scooters. Timing is done with chip technology with real-time results. Medical support is available on the course, at the finish, and in the facilities. The start of the first relay segment and the main race is between 9:45 and 9:55, the second relay segment starts at 9:20 with departure to the steamer. The race is limited to 700 participants and includes timing, technical facilities, medical support, and refreshments on the course and at the finish.

name: Hlučínská 24ka
description: Hlučínská 24ka is a unique 24-hour ultramarathon held in the beautiful surroundings of Hlučín Gravel Pit around Hlučín Lake. The race offers the opportunity to test your endurance by running as many laps as possible on a course measuring 6180 meters. In addition to the main individual race, a new event for pairs has been introduced, allowing participants to share the experience with a partner. The event also includes children's runs and shorter races for the general public, all in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizer is the Benešováci z.s. association, which emphasizes sportsmanship, fair play, and support for an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Loop length of 6180 meters around Hlučín Lake
Flat asphalt terrain without significant elevation changes
Beautiful natural environment of Hlučín Gravel Pit
additional: The race takes place from April 25, 2026, ending on April 26, 2026, at 9:00 AM with the 24-hour ultramarathon. Children's and shorter runs start from 14:00 to 15:00. The course is flat asphalt with low difficulty. Each participant receives a bib number and an ID chip; the bib number must be worn visibly. The organizer recommends a medical check-up before the race, and participation is at your own risk. A t-shirt for ultramarathoners is included. Facilities are located in a camp directly at Hlučín Gravel Pit. 24-hour ultramarathon, course length 6180 meters, held at Hlučín Gravel Pit, possibility of pairs race, accompanying activities.

name: Nížkovský běh u koupaliště
location: Nížkov u koupaliště, Nížkov, Czech Republic

This race has a long-standing tradition and is popular among local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area. The event offers an opportunity for athletes of all ages and levels to enjoy running in the pleasant environment of the Highlands. The organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and high-quality event organization.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race in the natural environment near the swimming pool in Nížkov
Organized by TJ Sokol Nížkov with a long-standing tradition
Race suitable for various age groups and running levels
additional: The race is part of the activities of TJ Sokol Nížkov, traditionally held in the spring, usually a week after Easter. A traditional spring race with participation from local and visiting runners, results available online, the race takes place at the swimming pool in Nížkov.

name: ALIS RUN - Bystřický běh s úsměvem
description: ALIS RUN - Bystřický run with a smile is a traditional running race held in the village of Bystřice. This friendly race offers a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including younger participants with written consent from a legal guardian. The race takes place on April 25, 2026, and participants run at their own risk with an emphasis on following safety instructions. The event also offers the opportunity to purchase the Alis Run 2026 T-shirt in pre-sale.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Bystřice
Support for the local charity 'Nikdy nejsi sám'
Friendly atmosphere and various running categories
additional: Participants under 18 years old can only participate with written consent from a responsible guardian. Each participant runs at their own risk and agrees to follow safety instructions. Participants consent to audiovisual recording of their participation and performance for the purpose of race presentation. Orders for Alis Run 2026 T-shirts are closed for this year. The registration fee will support the association 'Nikdy nejsi sám'; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Rychlebský maraton
description: The Rychlebský Marathon is a spring supplementary race set in the beautiful environment of the Rychlebské Mountains, known for their wild and remote nature. The routes lead along perfect mountain trails, through deep valleys, deserted cliffs, old mountain meadows, and abandoned settlements, offering runners an unforgettable experience of wilderness and stunning views. The race is suitable for everyone who wants to explore the Rychlebské Mountains through the eyes of experienced locals and enjoy running in nature with minimal asphalt. Available routes are 26 km, 46 km, and 76 km, with the longer variants also passing into neighboring Poland.
course_highlights: Routes run along perfect mountain trails and border paths
Across deep valleys, deserted cliffs, and mountain meadows of former settlements
Minimal asphalt, mostly forest trails and footpaths
additional: Registration is also possible on-site, but prior registration helps with preparation. Participants are divided into two age categories (up to 39 years and 40 years and above). The fee includes a fee for forest owners, a map, a start number, a chip timing system, a GPS tracker for the long route, a finishers' diploma, generous refreshment stations along the course, and a hot soup at the finish line (vegan and non-vegan options). Accommodation in a secondary gym in Javorník is available for 150 CZK/night. Trail ultramarathon on mountain trails, registration information, special programs including evening lectures, and location changes for race day.

description: The Nymburk Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque town of Nymburk, offering a flat course suitable for recreational runners as well as those training for longer races. The route passes through the town park, along the Labe cycle path, and over two bridges, with a total length of 21.1 km. For less experienced runners, a 10 km race is also available, which is a shorter variant of the main race. The race facilities are located beneath the town walls, creating a unique atmosphere for the event.
