name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
location: Jabłonna, Legionowo County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-format race that originated in the USA. Participants start every hour and must complete a loop of 6.706 km. After finishing the loop, they have rest time until the next full hour, and the competition continues until only one participant remains who completes the last loop within the time limit. It is an endurance race where not only speed but also strategy and perseverance matter.
course_highlights: Loop of 6.706 km (4.167 miles)
Start every full hour
Unique format - race lasts until a single winner is determined
additional: No podium - only a throne for the winner. Adult event. The time limit to complete each loop is 1 hour. Regulations and map available for download on the website. The event features the Backyard Ultra format, with participant limits and online registration. The series also includes winter editions and special editions with prizes such as the Silver Ticket to the World Championships.

Nighttime race atmosphere

The route consists of two loops of 4630 meters each and runs along the quay, with the start and finish located in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship. The race is open to active professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian competitors after prior verification. The event is held in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and the sporting spirit.

name: Ultra-Trail® Malopolska

Organized by the 4 Alternatives Foundation, it attracts runners who appreciate challenges and the beauty of mountain nature. Ultra-Trail® Małopolska is an excellent opportunity to test your strength on routes of varying difficulty and experience the unique atmosphere of ultra running.

Distances from 16 km to 240 km, including very demanding ultramarathons
Scenic and technical mountain trails

name: Biegi Śnieżnickie
location: Międzygórze, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Snow Mountain Runs are legendary mountain races held in the picturesque Międzygórze, in the heart of the Śnieżnik Massif. The routes feature demanding ascents and technical descents, leading through beautiful forest paths and gravel roads, as well as to the very summit of Śnieżnik. This event, with a rich tradition dating back to the 1990s, attracts both amateurs and elite runners from across Europe. Participants can choose between the classic alpine race of 9.6 km and the Snow Mountain Half Marathon of approximately 21 km, which encircles the Crown of Śnieżnik.

Mountain routes, races of 9.6 km, half marathon, marathon, scheduled for May 2026, with a history and tradition of mountain running.

description: The Piotrkowska Street Run Rossmann Run is one of the most important running events in Poland, taking place in the city center of Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. description: Poznaniak Run for Preschoolers is a family running event held on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Greater Poland National Park and at the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. additional: Race packets are issued at the event office on May 8-9. Starts are staggered according to distances, with the longest distance of 78 km starting at 05:00. The time limit to complete the 78 km distance is 15 hours. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. Athlete cards can be downloaded 5 days before the event after logging in at startlist.pl. Award ceremonies take place after the completion of each distance. Distances range from 6 km to 101 km, with time limits from 1 hour to 17.5 hours, various start packages, the possibility to start on multiple distances within the Challenge, mountain terrain, medical security, trail marking, nutrition points, GPS tracker (only for 78 km).

name: Bieg Herosa
description: The Hero Run is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering various distances and competition formats on challenging, sandy terrain. The most extreme competition is Nomad 9h, where participants fight against desert sand and their own limits for 9 hours, emphasizing strategy and endurance. Shorter distances are also available, such as Nomad 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometer loops, as well as races for children and special dog runs that highlight cooperation and trust between the handler and the dog. This event is for those seeking a sporting challenge and contact with nature in a unique desert climate.
course_highlights: Sandy, desert-like terrain requiring good technique and endurance
Long-distance competition up to 9 hours in extreme conditions
Special routes for dog runs and for children on distances from 200 to 1000 meters
additional: The event includes various forms of races: an extreme 9-hour run, 3-hour run, short loops of 5 and 7 km, races for children, and dog runs that require cooperation and trust between the competitor and their pet. The event focuses on overcoming personal limits, endurance, and strategy in difficult terrain conditions.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting event that connects participants and raises awareness about autism. The race takes place on an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area in Szczecin, and participation is primarily about personal satisfaction and overcoming oneself, regardless of the finishing position. The event also features joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, which further promotes integration.
course_highlights: The route runs along an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area
Inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers
additional: The number of spots is limited to 300 participants. Start packages can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, May 16, from 10:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on the day of the event from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories with different distances from 200 to 600 meters. The Race Office and start are located at the Szyszka restaurant. The race is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, taking place on an asphalt trail in Arkonka, with online registration available until May 10, 2025. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź - spring edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting this sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: cross-country, scenic routes, spring 2026 event

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a picturesque and challenging trail measuring 8.2 km, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Grand Prix Nordic Walking. The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sports competition and exploring local attractions such as the largest chodak and a banquet table. Participants can prepare by using certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route measuring 8.2 km
Picturesque but challenging terrain
Local attractions: banquet table, largest chodak, and tobacco box
additional: The event starts at 11:00 AM. Registration is open from March 18, 2026, to May 7, 2026. The route runs through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging the use of certified Nordic Walking trails available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views, and local attractions to enrich participants' Nordic Walking experience.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.2 km long, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Center. The race route is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with limited road traffic during the event. The event promotes popularization of running and recreation as well as integration of the local community. In addition to the main race, there are also races for children and youth on various distances suitable for their age. Participants of the main race receive a starter pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.
course_highlights: Route approximately 21.2 km, 100% asphalt
Flat route, marked every 1 km
Refreshment points at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and finish
additional: The main race has a time limit of 180 minutes. The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:15. The office for children opens at 10:00, with children's and youth races around 12:00-12:30, and awards ceremony approximately 12:30-13:00. Right-hand traffic is enforced on the route. Classifications include OPEN women and men as well as age categories for adults and children. Approximate distances for children: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I-III), 500 m (grades IV-VI), 800 m (grades VII-VIII). Registration for the event was available online. The event also includes races for children and community activities.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnicka Five-Kilometer Run is a race covering 5 kilometers held in the picturesque town of Płużnica. The course features varied surfaces, making it attractive for both amateurs and more experienced runners. Participants start in the town center, and the event includes children's races and a ceremonial award ceremony. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, as confirmed by positive feedback from previous participants.
course_highlights: 5 km course through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% cobblestone
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: Program of the day: 10:40 official start, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 award ceremony, 12:45 official end. The route starts in the town center. After the race, prizes and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments are provided. The participant limit is 200. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Chełmno Land. Online registration, timing measurement, and live results are available.

name: Mistrzostwa Gminy Kąty Wrocławskie w Bie...
location: Krobielowice, Kąty Wrocławskie, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Kąty Wrocławskie Municipality Cross Country Championships is a series of cross country races organized within the Kąty Wrocławskie municipality. The first event will take place in Krobielowice and invites runners to participate in this outdoor sporting competition. The event is local in nature and promotes physical activity and community integration.
course_highlights: Cross country races in the natural terrain of Kąty Wrocławskie municipality
The first race in picturesque Krobielowice
Course adapted for various runner categories
additional: The organizer is the Kąty Wrocławskie Running Club. The event is cyclical and takes place in different localities within the municipality. Registrations are conducted through a Facebook group. Sign-ups for the 2026 edition can be made on Facebook, and the event enjoys great interest from local runners.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles / IX Running Championships Provi Run is a street race covering a distance of 5.5 km, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Łódź. The event is dedicated to runners of various skill levels, and participants can benefit from training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The race is of moderate difficulty and takes place on an asphalt urban route. Organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help everyone prepare optimally for the start.
course_highlights: Street route of 5.5 km length
Race on asphalt surface in Łódź city
Customized training plans from 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Participants can choose a training plan matched to their VDOT level, with training instructions and expert support. Training lasts from 8 to 20 weeks, allowing for optimal race preparation. The race covers a distance of 5.5 km, with online registration, an eco-friendly event, categories for children and adults, support for foundations, starter packs with gifts, parking, and a meal after the race.

name: Rajd Beskidy Short

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Brak szczegółowych informacji o cenach w źródłach

description: Beskidy Short Race is a European adventure race held in the picturesque Beskid Mountains, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The competition includes various disciplines such as MTB, trekking, kayaking, climbing, and orienteering, with routes leading through mountainous areas offering beautiful views and challenging sections. The event is designed for teams of two or individual participants, providing an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are located in the Koszyce area, and organizers provide professional support and assistance.
course_highlights: Approximately 200 km route with MTB, trekking, and kayaking
Traversing the Beskid Mountains and Orawa region
Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing elements
additional: The race lasts about 30 hours plus an additional 2 hours. Teams can be mixed 4-person or 2-person of any gender. The race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes disciplines such as climbing, kayaking, navigation, and field tasks, with routes passing through scenic areas of Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmia Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in the picturesque Olsztyn. The route takes runners through charming Warmia trails, along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake, offering contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity for active recreation, suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can participate in the children's races Ultra Warmiaczek. The atmosphere of the competition fosters integration and shared sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Picturesque Warmia trails around Olsztyn
Route along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake
Contact with nature and charming views
additional: Packet pickup takes place on May 9, 2026, from 17:00 to 21:00 at the Best Western Plus Olsztyn Old Town Hotel and from 07:30 to 10:00 at CRS Ukiel for children's races. The start times for the W50+ and W25+ distances are at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, participants must leave the course and remove their bib numbers. The Ultra Warmiaczek children's races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center, near numerous hotels and apartments. The event includes distances of 53 km, 32 km, 19 km, and children's races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours, and the start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support. Registration closes on April 26, 2025.
